_source: UEV-A1 (docs/eras/uev.md, 'A1. Isotopes', line 2): the depleted-plutonium MOX row of IV's fuel fabrication plant. Real process: mixed-oxide fuel blends plutonium dioxide with uranium dioxide and sinters it into pellets in zircaloy tubes (MELOX, Sellafield MOX plant); the calutron's depleted plutonium is ordinary reactor-grade plutonium oxide.
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/iv/uranium_cycle.js after the transcurium rows; the same format. Circuit 8: 1-3 are IV's, 4-6 UV's, 7 UHV's.

The blend comes from the mixer row mox_blend of tables/isotopes.json (depleted plutonium oxide + uranium). The assembly is the same grindless:mox_fuel_assembly the hot cell makes (hot_cell.json), so the depleted plutonium returns to IV's MOX loop.
energy: one IV assembler stage (1,536,000 EU).

energy.stage: pressing and sintering the blend into pellets and loading them in zircaloy tubes: one IV assembler stage
